rewrites.//: Everything except built assets falls through to the SPA. The exclusion is the point: a catch-all answers a request for a hashed chunk that no longer exists with index.html at status 200, and a browser handed text/html for a module refuses to run it. The import then rejects with nothing useful, Suspense never resolves, and a pane simply never appears — which is what a deploy landing while somebody has the app open used to look like. Excluded, a stale chunk 404s honestly and the client can recognise it and reload. See src/lib/lazyChunk.ts.
